_provenance.notes: ZITADEL v4.18.0 live-confirmed. The per-app loginVersion is a camelCase oneof: {loginV1:{}} (built-in V1 UI, /ui/login, platform default) or {loginV2:{baseUri}} (separate zitadel-login container, /ui/v2/login). The DECIDING lever for which hosted-login UI the authorize endpoint routes to is the INSTANCE feature loginV2.required (bool) at PUT /v2/features/instance — NOT the per-app field; pinning the app alone does not override the instance default. This is the SVC-06 AC-3 dead-end: with the instance default loginV2.required=true and no V2 container deployed, authorize dead-ended at /ui/v2/login -> {"code":5}.
